query.esql:
FROM logs-corelight.ssl*
| WHERE event.dataset == "tls_agg"
| STATS count = COUNT()
| EVAL `SSL Aggregation` = CASE(count > 0, "SSL Agg Logs Available", "No SSL Agg Logs"),
    status = CASE(count > 0, 1, 0)
| KEEP `SSL Aggregation`, status

FROM logs-corelight.ssl*
| WHERE event.dataset == "tls_agg"
| STATS count = COUNT()
| EVAL `SSL Aggregation` = CASE(count > 0, "SSL Agg Logs Available", "No SSL Agg Logs"),
    status = CASE(count > 0, 1, 0)
| KEEP `SSL Aggregation`, status

FROM logs-corelight.*
| WHERE observer.vendor == "Corelight" AND  observer.hostname IS NOT NULL AND (event.dataset LIKE "x509*"
   OR event.dataset LIKE "tls*")
| EVAL `SSL Subject` = COALESCE(file.x509.subject.distinguished_name, tls.server.subject)
| WHERE `SSL Subject` IS NOT NULL
| STATS Count = COUNT() BY `SSL Subject`
| SORT Count DESC
| LIMIT 10
| KEEP `SSL Subject`, Count

FROM logs-corelight.*
| WHERE observer.vendor == "Corelight" AND  observer.hostname IS NOT NULL AND (event.dataset LIKE "x509*" 
   OR event.dataset LIKE "tls*")
| EVAL `SSL Subject` = COALESCE(file.x509.subject.distinguished_name, tls.server.subject)
| WHERE `SSL Subject` IS NOT NULL
| STATS Count = COUNT() BY `SSL Subject`
| SORT Count ASC

FROM logs-corelight.*
| WHERE observer.vendor == "Corelight"
  AND observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
  AND event.dataset LIKE "x509*"
  AND file.x509.not_after < NOW()
| KEEP file.x509.subject.distinguished_name, file.x509.not_after, file.x509.issuer.distinguished_name
| RENAME file.x509.subject.distinguished_name AS `SSL Subject`, file.x509.not_after AS `SSL End Time`, file.x509.issuer.distinguished_name AS `SSL Issuer`
